name: woutersf-marketplace
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins by Frederik Wouters.

plugins.name: mockup
plugins.description: Fast-track mockup generator for Dropsolid client prototypes. Supports four types: multi-mockup overview pages, single-page mockups, AI search integrations, and AI inspiration pitch decks. Extracts brand assets from a client site and builds Tailwind CSS prototypes with zero external dependencies.

plugins.name: no-emdashes
plugins.description: Strictly prevents em dashes and all dash variants in every Claude response. Injects a no-dash rule into every conversation and automatically catches and corrects any em dash that slips through.
